text:
maya: Quick heads-up — during a demo I rotated the project-scoped key and a few node sampleapp streams returned 401s for ~30s. Looks like the streaming client keeps a pointer to the old token.

sam: Which SDK? Any credential cache?

maya: node SDK v0.9.x. We added a tiny creds cache to avoid KMS calls; streamer holds a ref and doesn't rebind per-request.

liz: We should expose a creds.onChange event so long-lived clients can swap auth atomically.

ash: Also saw a parity issue: sampleapp docs say REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY but SDK reads REDWOOD_API_KEY_PROJECT. Suggest normalize to REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY and add a compatibility shim that logs a deprecation warning.

sam: Action items: add creds.onChange + tests, patch streamer to subscribe and rebind on change, unify env var names in docs and SDKs, and add a short repro integration test that rotates mid-stream.

maya: I'll add the repro and patch the sampleapp docs today. Thanks.
